skill.summary: Fulfillment setup — Fulfilled by TikTok, self-fulfillment, shipping templates, return policies

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of TikTok Shop fulfillment guidance skill:

- Offers expert advice on fulfillment setup: Fulfilled by TikTok, self-fulfillment, shipping templates, and return policies.
- Analyzes shop setups, identifies optimization opportunities, and provides step-by-step implementation plans.
- Compares strategies and tools with actionable recommendations and pros/cons.
- Outputs structured assessments, action items, timelines, and KPIs.
- Guidance only—no direct TikTok API integration or real-time analytics.
